name: Projected VC Radius
definition: The **Projected VC Radius** is the maximum effective VC radius among all coordinate projections of $\mathcal{H}$. Equivalently, it is the VC dimension of $\mathcal{H}$.
graph_summary: Largest effective VC radius among coordinate projections; equal to VC dimension.
origin_references: The shattering/strong-shattering sandwich framework underlying this equality is due to \cite{bollobas1995defect}.

doubly_monotonic.proof: By definition, being monotonic under both subfamilies and projections is doubly monotonic.

c_monotonic.proof: A conditioning is restriction to a subfamily followed by a projection; hence doubly monotonicity implies c-monotonicity.

monotonic.proof: This parameter is exactly equal to VC Dimension by the established relationship `projected_vc_radius_vc_dimension`; its monotonic classification transfers unchanged.

p_monotonic.proof: This parameter is exactly equal to VC Dimension by the established relationship `projected_vc_radius_vc_dimension`; its p monotonic classification transfers unchanged.

strictly_monotonic.proof: This parameter is exactly equal to VC Dimension by the established relationship `projected_vc_radius_vc_dimension`; its strictly monotonic classification transfers unchanged.
